_comment: First-session tutorial. target: where the pointing hand goes. wait: event that completes the step. skip: comma-separated conditions that auto-skip the step - stat:<name> grew or more:<building> owned since the tutorial started, or none:<empty_plot|deliverable|plot_buyable> when it cannot be done right now. button: label for 'tap' steps.

steps.text: Hi {name}, welcome to Cozy Acres! This little farm is all yours. Let's grow something!
Tap an empty field to start planting.
Wheat is picked for you. Tap or swipe across the empty fields to plant 3!
Golden wheat is ready to pick! Swipe across the golden fields to harvest.
Villagers pin orders on the Order Board. Tap it to take a look!
You have everything this order needs. Tap Deliver for coins and XP!
Lovely! More fields means more crops. Open the Shop.
Pick a Field, drag it to a free spot and tap the tick to build it.
You're a natural, {name}! The goal card always shows a good next step. Happy farming!
